supporting_ids: s2:Integral Field Spectroscopy of 13 Tidal Disruption Event Hosts from the Zwicky T
rationale: The papers 'The Host Galaxies of Tidal Disruption Events' (2003.02863), 'Rare Occasions: Tidal Disruption Events Rarely Power the AGNs Observed in Dwarf Galaxies' (2410.02484), and 'Integral Field Spectroscopy of 13 Tidal Disruption Event Hosts from the Zwicky Transient Facility Survey' provide insights into TDE rates and host galaxy properties, contributing evidence relevant to the question about discrepancies in TDE rates and their relation to star formation in dwarf galaxies.
